crossRefs.note: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread, and drink of the cup.
When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
“I have surely heard Ephraim grieving thus, ‘You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as an untrained calf. Turn me…
I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight.
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly…
Wake up, and keep the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours…
Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If therefore you won’t watch, I will come as a…

translations.web: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.
translations.bsb: Now if we judged ourselves properly, we would not come under judgment.
translations.kjv: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.
translations.asv: But if we discerned ourselves, we should not be judged.
